hypothesis: createReservationItems_ calls ensureInventoryLevels, which validates each reservation entry's quantity against the level's available quantity independently, never summing entries for the same inventory item. A cart with OVS-PIECE x6 and OVS-TWOPACK x3 needs 12 WIDGET units, but each line (6 and 6) passes alone against 10 in stock. The order completes and reserves 12 > 10 stocked, so no_oversell should fail.
